"Hi Anand, welcome!  It's great to finally meet you. Thanks for taking the time to interview today.  I've reviewed your resume and I'm particularly impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based Digital Mall system and your GameZork platform – those demonstrate a nice range of skills.

To get us started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself, your background, and what kind of role you're hoping to find?"
Okay, Anand,  your Digital Mall project mentions using Java and MySQL.  Can you describe a specific challenge you encountered during its development and how you overcame it?
